$comment: Key Security Indicators that do not apply to this system, each with why, who proposed it and the operator's approval. Read by scripts/_ksi_applicability.py; scripts/build-ksi-signal.py and scripts/build-sdr.py leave a listed KSI out of the inventory's results and the method count, and the SDR publishes it with its reason. Every other KSI's status is computed from its checks, never written here.

ksis.not_applicable: The system holds no federal customer data and has no agency customer, so there is no customer data an agency could ask to have removed.
